answer: One concrete defence is a stake-and-gossip vault: every agent locks a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can transact, so spinning up thousands of fake identities becomes expensive. Peers then share a quiet whisper network of signed reputation reports, flagging agents that behave identically or transact only with each other. New agents start in a velvet-rope probationary tier with low limits until their stake and history prove them real, and proven sybils lose their stake.
